description_en: Queries the status of automatic resource group transfer settings by calling GetAutoGroupingStatus
description_zh: 调用GetAutoGroupingStatus查询自动转组设置状态
name: GetAutoGroupingStatus

EnableExistedResourcesTransfer.description_en:
Indicates whether the attached-resource allocation for existing resources is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
EnableExistedResourcesTransfer.description_zh:
存量资源关联转组是否开启。取值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启

EnableStatus.description_en:
The status of automatic resource group transfer. Valid values:
Enabling: Being enabled.
Enable: Enabled.
Partial_Enable: Attached-resource allocation is enabled, but custom condition-based resource group transfer is not enabled. To enable custom condition-based resource group transfer, call [EnableAutoGrouping](~~EnableAutoGrouping~~).
Disable: Not enabled
EnableStatus.description_zh:
自动转组开通状态。取值：
Enabling：开通中。
Enable：已开通。
Partial_Enable：关联资源跟随转组已开通，自定义条件转组未开通。如需要开通自定义条件转组，请调用[EnableAutoGrouping](~~EnableAutoGrouping~~)。
Disable：未开通
